name: straight_in_misclassified
note: Pull Queue: a straight-in that looks like base. N399 is on the extended centerline 90 s from the base-to-final turn point, crabbing 25 deg off the final heading as it joins, while N101 flies the pattern. The node must not read N399 as a BASE leg (it is STRAIGHT_IN or low-confidence, which means straight-line prediction) and must not invent a turn for it.
